Script.name: Yso coordinated release library
Script.script:
-- Native package library; loaded before the independent workspace controller. -- It reads release data, never loads executable Lua from filesystem paths. YsoRelease=YsoRelease or {} local B=YsoRelease B.version=1 local MOD=4294967296 local native=bit32 or bit local xor,band,rshift,ror if native and native.bxor and native.band and native.rshift then xor=function(a,b) return native.bxor(a,b)%MOD end band=function(a,b) return native.band(a,b)%MOD end rshift=function(a,n) return native.rshift(a,n)%MOD end ror=function(a,n) return (rshift(a,n)+(a%2^n)*2^(32-n))%MOD end else local compiler=loadstring or load local ok,chunk=pcall(compiler,'return function(a,b) return (a ~ b) & 0xffffffff end, function(a,b) return a & b end, function(a,n) return a >> n end') if ok and chunk then xor,band,rshift=chunk() end if not xor then local small={};for a=0,15 do small[a]={};for b=0,15 do local aa,bb,v,p=a,b,0,1;for _=1,4 do if aa%2~=bb%2 then v=v+p end;aa=math.floor(aa/2);bb=math.floor(bb/2);p=p*2 end;small[a][b]=v end end xor=function(a,b) local v,p=0,1;for _=1,8 do v=v+small[a%16][b%16]*p;a=math.floor(a/16);b=math.floor(b/16);p=p*16 end;return v end band=function(a,b) return (a+b-xor(a,b))/2 end rshift=function(a,n) return math.floor(a/2^n) end end ror=function(a,n) return (rshift(a,n)+(a%2^n)*2^(32-n))%MOD end end local K={1116352408,1899447441,3049323471,3921009573,961987163,1508970993,2453635748,2870763221, 3624381080,310598401,607225278,1426881987,1925078388,2162078206,2614888103,3248222580, 3835390401,4022224774,264347078,604807628,770255983,1249150122,1555081692,1996064986, 2554220882,2821834349,2952996808,3210313671,3336571891,3584528711,113926993,338241895, 666307205,773529912,1294757372,1396182291,1695183700,1986661051,2177026350,2456956037, 2730485921,2820302411,3259730800,3345764771,3516065817,3600352804,4094571909,275423344, 430227734,506948616,659060556,883997877,958139571,1322822218,1537002063,1747873779, 1955562222,2024104815,2227730452,2361852424,2428436474,2756734187,3204031479,3329325298} local function word(n) return string.char(rshift(n,24)%256,rshift(n,16)%256,rshift(n,8)%256,n%256) end function B.sha256(s) local length=#s s=s..'\128'..string.rep('\0',(55-length)%64)..word(math.floor(length/536870912))..word((length*8)%MOD) local H={1779033703,3144134277,1013904242,2773480762,1359893119,2600822924,528734635,1541459225} for at=1,#s,64 do local w={};for j=0,15 do local a,b,c,d=s:byte(at+j*4,at+j*4+3);w[j+1]=((a*256+b)*256+c)*256+d end for j=17,64 do local a,b=w[j-15],w[j-2] local sa=xor(xor(ror(a,7),ror(a,18)),rshift(a,3));local sb=xor(xor(ror(b,17),ror(b,19)),rshift(b,10)) w[j]=(w[j-16]+sa+w[j-7]+sb)%MOD end local a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h=H[1],H[2],H[3],H[4],H[5],H[6],H[7],H[8] for j=1,64 do local s1=xor(xor(ror(e,6),ror(e,11)),ror(e,25));local ch=xor(band(e,f),band(MOD-1-e,g)) local t1=(h+s1+ch+K[j]+w[j])%MOD local s0=xor(xor(ror(a,2),ror(a,13)),ror(a,22));local maj=xor(xor(band(a,b),band(a,c)),band(b,c)) h=g;g=f;f=e;e=(d+t1)%MOD;d=c;c=b;b=a;a=(t1+s0+maj)%MOD end local v={a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h};for j=1,8 do H[j]=(H[j]+v[j])%MOD end end local result={};for j=1,8 do result[j]=string.format('%08x',H[j]) end;return table.concat(result) end local expected={ {'legacy','Legacy V2.1'},{'ak','AK'},{'limb','limb.1.2'},{'yso','Yso system'}, {'basher','Legacy Basher V2.1'},{'ui','Legacy UI V2.0'},{'controller','Yso Workspace Link'}, } local function read(path) local f=io.open(path,'rb');if not f then return nil end;local s=f:read('*a');f:close();return s end local function write(path,s) local f,why=io.open(path,'wb');if not f then return false,why end local ok,e=f:write(s);local closed,ce=f:close();if not ok or not closed then return false,e or ce or 'write_failed' end;return true end local function decode(s) if type(s)~='string' or not (yajl and type(yajl.to_value)=='function') then return nil end local ok,v=pcall(yajl.to_value,s);if ok and type(v)=='table' then return v end end local function encode(v) if not (yajl and type(yajl.to_string)=='function') then return nil end local ok,s=pcall(yajl.to_string,v);if ok and type(s)=='string' then return s end end local function contains(t,n) if type(t)~='table' then return false end;if t[n] then return true end for _,v in ipairs(t) do if v==n then return true end end;return false end local function valid_xml(s) return type(s)=='string' and s:find('<MudletPackage[%s>]') and s:match('</MudletPackage>%s*$')~=nil end local function validate_manifest(m) if type(m)~='table' or m.schema_version~=1 or type(m.release_id)~='string' or not m.release_id:match('^[%w._-]+$') or type(m.packages)~='table' or #m.packages~=#expected then return false,'invalid_release_manifest' end local seen={} for i,spec in ipairs(expected) do local p=m.packages[i] if type(p)~='table' or p.id~=spec[1] or p.name~=spec[2] or p.file~=spec[2]..'.xml' or p.required~=true or type(p.sha256)~='string' or #p.sha256~=64 or not p.sha256:match('^[a-fA-F0-9]+$') or type(p.lua_sha256)~='string' or #p.lua_sha256~=64 or not p.lua_sha256:match('^[a-fA-F0-9]+$') or type(p.lua_chunks)~='number' or p.lua_chunks<0 or p.lua_chunks%1~=0 or type(p.depends_on)~='table' then return false,'invalid_release_package:'..spec[1] end for _,dependency in ipairs(p.depends_on) do if not seen[dependency] then return false,'dependency_order:'..p.id end end seen[p.id]=true end return true end local function current(R) local base=R.root..'/Ysindrolir/releases' local pointer=decode(read(base..'/current.json')) if not pointer or type(pointer.directory)~='string' or not pointer.directory:match('^[%w_-][%w._-]*$') or pointer.directory:find('..',1,true) then return nil,'release_not_published' end local dir=base..'/'..pointer.directory local text=read(dir..'/manifest.json');local m=decode(text) local ok,why=validate_manifest(m);if not ok then return nil,why end return m,dir,text end local function metadata(bytes,receipt,name,spec) if type(receipt)~='string' then return false,'unpublished_xml:'..name end local ending=receipt:find('
',1,true);if not ending then return false,'invalid_receipt:'..name end local n=tonumber(receipt:sub(1,ending-1));if n~=#bytes or receipt:sub(ending+1,ending+n)~=bytes then return false,'invalid_receipt:'..name end local pos=ending+n+1;local compiler=loadstring or load;local count=0 if B.sha256(receipt:sub(pos))~=spec.lua_sha256:lower() then return false,'invalid_receipt:'..name end while pos<=#receipt do ending=receipt:find('
',pos,true);if not ending then return false,'invalid_receipt:'..name end local digits=receipt:sub(pos,ending-1);if not digits:match('^%d+$') then return false,'invalid_receipt:'..name end n=tonumber(digits);if n>#receipt-ending then return false,'invalid_receipt:'..name end if not compiler(receipt:sub(ending+1,ending+n),name..':release preflight') then return false,'invalid_lua:'..name end count=count+1 pos=ending+n+1 end if count~=spec.lua_chunks then return false,'invalid_receipt:'..name end return true end local function connection() if type(getConnectionInfo)~='function' then return nil end local ok,_,_,connected=pcall(getConnectionInfo) if ok and type(connected)=='boolean' then return connected end end local digest_cache={} local function digest(path,bytes) if not bytes then return nil end local cached=digest_cache[path] if not cached or cached.bytes~=bytes then cached={bytes=bytes,sha256=B.sha256(bytes)};digest_cache[path]=cached end return cached.sha256 end function B.bind(R) local function home() return getMudletHomeDir():gsub('\','/'):gsub('/+$','')..'/yso-workspace' end local function say(s) if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<steel_blue>[Yso release] <reset>'..s..'
') end end local function hold(reason) Yso=Yso or {};Yso.pause=Yso.pause or {};Yso.pause.offense=Yso.pause.offense or {} Yso.pause.offense.active=true;Yso.pause.offense.reason=reason local M=Yso.mode if M and type(M.start_route_loop)=='function' and M.start_route_loop~=R.release_guard then local original=M.start_route_loop;R.release_guard=function(...) if R.busy or R.restart_required then return false,'release_restart_required' end;return original(...) end;M.start_route_loop=R.release_guard end end local function later(key,delay,fn) local id=R.timers[key];if id and type(killTimer)=='function' then killTimer(id) end local generation=R.generation R.timers[key]=tempTimer(delay,function() if generation~=R.generation then return end;R.timers[key]=nil;fn() end) end local function fail(why) for _,key in ipairs({'bundle_operation','bundle_timeout'}) do if R.timers[key] and type(killTimer)=='function' then killTimer(R.timers[key]) end;R.timers[key]=nil end local job=R.bundle_current if job and job.previous then write(home()..'/modules/'..job.name..'.xml',job.previous) end R.busy=false;R.bundle_current=nil;R.last_result='failed';R.last_error=tostring(why);R.restart_required=true hold('release_restart_required') say('Installation stopped: '..R.last_error..'. A partial update is possible. Restart only after recovery; automation remains blocked.') if R.backup_path then say('Profile backup: '..R.backup_path) end end function R.release_status() local m,why=current(R) local installed=decode(read(home()..'/release-installed.json')) local rows,consistent={},installed~=nil if installed then local valid=validate_manifest(installed);consistent=valid end if installed and consistent then for _,p in ipairs(installed.packages) do local path=home()..'/modules/'..p.name..'.xml' local present=type(getModules)=='function' and contains(getModules(),p.name) local managed=present and type(getModulePath)=='function' and tostring(getModulePath(p.name) or ''):gsub('\','/')==path local bytes=read(path) local exact=bytes~=nil and bytes==read(home()..'/modules/'..p.name..'.applied.xml') local expected_hash=digest(path,bytes)==p.sha256:lower() local okay=managed and exact and expected_hash rows[#rows+1]={id=p.id,name=p.name,sha256=p.sha256,installed=present,consistent=okay} consistent=consistent and okay end end local conflicts={} for _,n in ipairs({'stormhammer aliases','stormhammer script','Target things'}) do if (type(getPackages)=='function' and contains(getPackages(),n)) or (type(getModules)=='function' and contains(getModules(),n)) then conflicts[#conflicts+1]=n end end return {id=installed and installed.release_id or nil,available_id=m and m.release_id or nil, available=m~=nil,reason=not m and why or nil,consistent=consistent,packages=rows,conflicts=conflicts, restart_required=R.restart_required==true} end function R.validate_hot_reload(jobs) local installed=decode(read(home()..'/release-installed.json')) if not installed then return false,'coordinated_install_required' end if R.restart_required or not R.release_status().consistent then return false,'release_restart_required' end local m,why,text=current(R);if not m then return false,why end local submitted={};for _,job in ipairs(jobs) do submitted[job.name]=job.bytes end for i,p in ipairs(installed.packages) do local next=m.packages[i] if p.id=='ak' or p.id=='yso' then if not submitted[p.name] or B.sha256(submitted[p.name])~=next.sha256:lower() then return false,'release_not_published:'..p.name end elseif p.sha256:lower()~=next.sha256:lower() then return false,'full_install_required:'..p.name end end R.pending_hot_manifest=m;R.pending_hot_text=text return true end function R.commit_hot_release() if not R.pending_hot_manifest then return true end for _,p in ipairs(R.pending_hot_manifest.packages) do local path=home()..'/modules/'..p.name..'.xml' local bytes=read(path) if digest(path,bytes)~=p.sha256:lower() or bytes~=read(home()..'/modules/'..p.name..'.applied.xml') then return false,'release_snapshot_mismatch:'..p.name end end local okay,why=write(home()..'/release-installed.json',R.pending_hot_text) if not okay then return false,'installed_manifest:'..tostring(why) end R.pending_hot_manifest=nil;R.pending_hot_text=nil;return true end local function offline() if type(getProfileName)~='function' or getProfileName()~='Achaea' then return false,'wrong_profile' end local connected=connection();if connected==nil then return false,'connection_state_unknown' end if connected then return false,'connected' end return true end local function preflight() local ok,why=offline();if not ok then return nil,why end if Yso and type(Yso.mode)=='table' and type(R.idle)=='function' then local idle,reason=R.idle();if not idle then return nil,reason end end if Legacy and Legacy.Settings and Legacy.Settings.Basher and Legacy.Settings.Basher.status==true then return nil,'automation_active' end for _,name in ipairs({'getPackages','getModules','getModulePath','installModule','reloadModule','uninstallPackage','setModulePriority','disableModuleSync','saveProfile','registerAnonymousEventHandler','tempTimer'}) do if type(_G[name])~='function' then return nil,'missing_api:'..name end end if not (lfs and type(lfs.mkdir)=='function') then return nil,'filesystem_api_unavailable' end local m,dir,text=current(R);if not m then return nil,dir end if not encode(m) then return nil,'serialization_unavailable' end local jobs={} for i,p in ipairs(m.packages) do local bytes=read(dir..'/'..p.file) if not valid_xml(bytes) then return nil,'invalid_xml:'..p.name end if B.sha256(bytes)~=p.sha256:lower() then return nil,'hash_mismatch:'..p.name end local valid,reason=metadata(bytes,read(dir..'/'..p.name..'.validated'),p.name,p);if not valid then return nil,reason end local mod=contains(getModules(),p.name);local pkg=contains(getPackages(),p.name) if mod and pkg then return nil,'ambiguous_install:'..p.name end local path=home()..'/modules/'..p.name..'.xml' if mod and tostring(getModulePath(p.name) or ''):gsub('\','/')~=path then return nil,'unmanaged_module:'..p.name end jobs[i]={id=p.id,name=p.name,bytes=bytes,sha256=p.sha256:lower(),was_module=mod,was_package=pkg,previous=read(path),priority=i-1} end return {jobs=jobs,manifest=m,text=text} end local next_job local function finish(job) if not R.busy or R.bundle_current~=job or not job.ack then return end local ok,why=offline();if not ok then fail(why);return end local path=home()..'/modules/'..job.name..'.xml' if tostring(getModulePath(job.name) or ''):gsub('\','/')~=path or read(path)~=job.bytes then fail('module_input_changed:'..job.name);return end local configured,err=pcall(function() setModulePriority(job.name,job.priority);disableModuleSync(job.name) end) if not configured then fail('module_configuration:'..tostring(err));return end local saved,e=write(home()..'/modules/'..job.name..'.applied.xml',job.bytes);if not saved then fail('snapshot:'..tostring(e));return end saved,e=write(home()..'/modules/'..job.name..'.sha256',job.sha256);if not saved then fail('snapshot_hash:'..tostring(e));return end if R.timers.bundle_timeout and type(killTimer)=='function' then killTimer(R.timers.bundle_timeout) end;R.timers.bundle_timeout=nil R.bundle_current=nil;later('bundle_operation',0.1,next_job) end next_job=function() if not R.busy then return end local okay,reason=offline();if not okay then fail(reason);return end R.bundle_index=R.bundle_index+1;local job=R.bundle_jobs[R.bundle_index] if not job then local saved,e=write(home()..'/release-installed.json',R.bundle_manifest_text) if not saved then fail('installed_manifest:'..tostring(e));return end R.busy=false;R.bundle_current=nil;R.last_result='installed_restart_required';R.last_error=nil hold('release_restart_required');say('Coordinated release installed. Restart this profile before connecting or resuming automation.');return end R.bundle_current=job;hold('release_restart_required') local okay,e=write(home()..'/modules/'..job.name..'.xml',job.bytes);if not okay then fail('stage:'..tostring(e));return end later('bundle_timeout',20,function() R.last_result='waiting';R.last_error='waiting_for_native_module:'..job.name;say('Waiting for '..job.name..'. Updates and automation remain blocked; restart only after recovery.') end) local called,result,err=pcall(function() if job.was_package then uninstallPackage(job.name);if contains(getPackages(),job.name) then return false,'package_removal_failed' end end if job.was_module then return reloadModule(job.name) end return installModule(home()..'/modules/'..job.name..'.xml') end) if not called or result==false or (result==nil and err~=nil) then fail(job.name..':'..tostring(called and err or result)) end end function R.install() if R.busy then return false,'busy' end local bundle,why=preflight();if not bundle then say('Installation held: '..tostring(why));return false,why end for _,dir in ipairs({home(),home()..'/modules',home()..'/backups'}) do local ok,e=lfs.mkdir(dir);if not ok and not (lfs.attributes and lfs.attributes(dir,'mode')=='directory') then -- mkdir may return nil for an existing directory. A file read is not a valid substitute. if type(lfs.attributes)=='function' then return false,'directory_unavailable:'..tostring(e) end end end R.sequence=(R.sequence or 0)+1;local filename='before-release-'..os.time()..'-'..R.sequence R.bundle_backup_dir=home()..'/backups/'..filename local made,e=lfs.mkdir(R.bundle_backup_dir);if not made and type(lfs.attributes)=='function' and lfs.attributes(R.bundle_backup_dir,'mode')~='directory' then return false,'backup_directory:'..tostring(e) end R.backup_path=R.bundle_backup_dir..'/profile.xml' R.busy=true;R.action='install';R.restart_required=true;R.bundle_jobs=bundle.jobs;R.bundle_index=0 R.bundle_manifest_text=bundle.text;R.last_error=nil;hold('release_restart_required') local ok,result,err=pcall(saveProfile,R.bundle_backup_dir,'profile') if not ok or result==false or (result==nil and err~=nil) then fail('profile_backup_failed');return false,'profile_backup_failed' end local attempts=0 local function await_backup() if not R.busy then return end local valid,why=offline();if not valid then fail(why);return end attempts=attempts+1 if valid_xml(read(R.backup_path)) then -- Complete all managed-file backups before replacing the first package. for _,job in ipairs(R.bundle_jobs) do if job.previous then local saved,e=write(R.bundle_backup_dir..'/'..job.name..'.xml',job.previous) if not saved or read(R.bundle_backup_dir..'/'..job.name..'.xml')~=job.previous then fail('managed_backup:'..tostring(e or job.name));return end end end local saved,e=write(home()..'/release-pending.json',R.bundle_manifest_text) if not saved then fail('pending_manifest:'..tostring(e));return end later('bundle_operation',0.1,next_job) elseif attempts>=50 then fail('profile_backup_timeout') else later('bundle_operation',0.2,await_backup) end end later('bundle_operation',0.1,await_backup);return true end function R.check_release() local bundle,why=preflight();return bundle~=nil,why end -- Self-updates remove the old native owner's handlers. Re-arm this callback -- from the replacement controller while its operation state is still live. if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then if R.handlers.bundle_install and type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler,R.handlers.bundle_install) end R.handlers.bundle_install=registerAnonymousEventHandler('sysInstall',function(_,name,errors) local job=R.bundle_current;if not (R.busy and R.action=='install' and job and job.name==name) then return end hold('release_restart_required') if type(errors)=='string' and errors~='' then fail(name..':'..errors);return end job.ack=true;later('bundle_operation',0.1,function() finish(job) end) end) end if R.restart_required==nil then local installed_text=read(home()..'/release-installed.json') local pending_text=read(home()..'/release-pending.json') local installed=decode(installed_text) local pending=decode(pending_text) local consistent=R.release_status().consistent R.restart_required=(pending~=nil or installed~=nil) and not consistent or false if (installed_text and installed_text~='' and not installed) or (pending_text and pending_text~='' and not pending) then R.restart_required=true end if pending then local valid=validate_manifest(pending) local installed_valid=installed and validate_manifest(installed) if not valid or not installed_valid or pending.release_id~=installed.release_id then R.restart_required=true elseif #pending.packages~=#installed.packages then R.restart_required=true else for i,p in ipairs(pending.packages) do local other=installed.packages[i] if p.id~=other.id or p.sha256:lower()~=other.sha256:lower() then R.restart_required=true end end end end if pending and not R.restart_required then local saved=write(home()..'/release-pending.json','') if not saved then R.restart_required=true end end end if R.restart_required then hold('release_restart_required') end return R end return B

Script.name: Achaea workspace link controller
Script.script:
-- Independent controller: never embed this in either module it reloads. -- Workspace XMLs are read-only inputs; Mudlet owns only profile-local copies. YsoWorkspaceLink=YsoWorkspaceLink or {} local R=YsoWorkspaceLink if R.busy then -- A full update may replace this controller last. Its previous native owner -- has been removed, so the replacement must own the completion callback. if YsoRelease and type(YsoRelease.bind)=='function' then YsoRelease.bind(R) end return R end R.root=R.root or 'C:/Users/shuji/OneDrive/Desktop/Yso systems' R.handlers=R.handlers or {};R.watches=R.watches or {};R.timers=R.timers or {} R.generation=(R.generation or 0)+1 R.sequence=R.sequence or 0 local generation=R.generation local names={'AK','Yso system'} local function normalize(p) return tostring(p or ''):gsub('\','/'):gsub('/+$',''):lower() end local function home() return getMudletHomeDir():gsub('\','/'):gsub('/+$','')..'/yso-workspace' end local function source(name) return R.root..'/Ysindrolir/mudlet packages/'..name..'.xml' end local function staged(name) return home()..'/modules/'..name..'.xml' end local function applied(name) return home()..'/modules/'..name..'.applied.xml' end local function published(name,suffix) return R.root..'/Ysindrolir/.workspace-link-publish/'..name..suffix end local function say(s) if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<steel_blue>[Yso workspace] <reset>'..s..'
') end end local function read(path) local f=io.open(path,'rb');if not f then return nil end local s=f:read('*a');f:close();return s end local function write(path,data) local f,e=io.open(path,'wb');if not f then return false,e end local ok,why=f:write(data);local closed,close_error=f:close() if not ok or not closed then return false,why or close_error or 'write_failed' end return true end local function contains(t,name) if type(t)~='table' then return false end if t[name] then return true end for _,v in ipairs(t) do if v==name then return true end end return false end local function valid_xml(s) return type(s)=='string' and s:find('<MudletPackage[%s>]')~=nil and s:match('</MudletPackage>%s*$')~=nil end local function validation_receipt(name,bytes) local receipt=read(published(name,'.validated')) if not receipt then return nil end local ending=receipt:find('
',1,true) if not ending or not receipt:sub(1,ending-1):match('^%d+$') then return nil end local length=tonumber(receipt:sub(1,ending-1)) if length~=#bytes or receipt:sub(ending+1,ending+length)~=bytes then return nil end return receipt:sub(ending+length+1) end local function valid_lua_metadata(name,data) local pos=1;local compiler=loadstring or load while pos<=#data do local ending=data:find('
',pos,true) if not ending then return false end local digits=data:sub(pos,ending-1) if not digits:match('^%d+$') then return false end local length=tonumber(digits) if not length or length>#data-ending then return false end local body=data:sub(ending+1,ending+length) if not compiler(body,name..':workspace preflight') then return false end pos=ending+length+1 end return true end local function cancel(key) if R.timers[key] and type(killTimer)=='function' then pcall(killTimer,R.timers[key]) end R.timers[key]=nil end local function later(key,seconds,fn) cancel(key) R.timers[key]=tempTimer(seconds,function() if R.generation~=generation then return end R.timers[key]=nil;fn() end) end local function resolve(namespace) local value=_G for part in tostring(namespace or ''):gmatch('[^.]+') do if type(value)~='table' then return nil end value=value[part] end return value end local function pending_work(pending) if type(pending)~='table' then return pending~=nil and
